_comment: Who sent a chat message, as both plugins put it in trigger.sender. `chat` is a direct message or a group (any group chat, server channel or thread); `owner` says the sender is the host's owner (OpenClaw's owner flag; on Hermes, individually on <PLATFORM>_ALLOWED_USERS or GATEWAY_ALLOWED_USERS). Both plugins must give the same `relation` and the same answer to whether the basis carries `group_chat`. The owner in a group stays the owner, with basis group_chat; everyone else there is other.
